$comment: Work side opening hours (ADR 0138 rule 4, bipe-chat/bipe#511). A company account sets the hours of its work side on the phone; the API keeps them (GET and PUT /v1/me/work-hours) so every device of the account reads the same. Outside the hours, the phone shows the account's pushes without sound and without a banner, and keeps them in the notification list. The personal side never goes quiet because of the work side. Reference: isWithinWorkHours() in tools/lib/registries.mjs, cases in test-vectors/work-hours.json. days: ISO weekdays 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday); a day without a range is closed. A range is half-open [start, end) in local time HH:MM; end 24:00 means midnight; a range never crosses midnight (two ranges cover a night). At most maxRangesPerDay ranges per day, sorted, not touching. defaultTimeZone is used when the account has none. defaultDays is what a new work account starts with.
